differences.a_observable: The tiles are framed closely, filling most of the screen.
differences.b_observable: The camera is pulled back, making the tiles appear much smaller with excess empty space.
differences.fix: Adjust camera distance or zoom to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: The white tiles exhibit a cool blue color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white tiles are neutral warm grey.
differences.fix: Apply a cool blue color grading to the scene.

differences.a_observable: The shadows between the tiles are deep and dark, providing high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are bright and soft, leading to a flat, low-contrast look.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera framing and distance to match the close-up composition of the reference video.

differences.a_observable: Camera is closer, tilted, with background elements blurred by depth of field.
differences.b_observable: Camera is further back, flatter, with all elements in sharp focus.
differences.fix: Bring camera closer, tilt it, and enable depth of field.

differences.a_observable: Directional lighting with a strong vignette darkening the corners.
differences.b_observable: Flat, uniform lighting with minimal corner falloff.
differences.fix: Add a vignette and use directional light sources.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust camera distance, tilt, and depth of field to match the reference perspective.

differences.a_observable: The camera is close to the cards at an angle with shallow depth of field, blurring the background.
differences.b_observable: The camera is far away at a high angle with deep depth of field, keeping everything sharp.
differences.fix: Reposition the camera closer, match the angled perspective, and enable depth of field.

differences.a_observable: Strong directional lighting creates deep, soft shadows between the raised cards.
differences.b_observable: Flat, ambient lighting results in very faint shadows, making the cards appear flat.
differences.fix: Add a strong directional light source and adjust shadow settings to deepen shadows.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card and blue accents on surrounding cards are highly saturated.
differences.b_observable: The colors are muted, with a less saturated yellow card and mostly grayscale surrounding cards.
differences.fix: Increase the saturation of the yellow card and add vibrant blue materials to surrounding cards.

differences.a_observable: The cards are tightly packed and have varying heights, creating a layered 3D grid.
differences.b_observable: The cards are sparsely distributed on a single flat plane with no vertical variation.
differences.fix: Adjust the layout of the cards to be tightly packed and vary their heights.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Reposition the camera closer to the cards at a dynamic angle, enable depth of field, and adjust the lighting to create deep, soft shadows that emphasize the 3D layout.
